decisions: | R-next | 2026-10-30 | Claude Code 2.1.307 and later (2.1.312 checked on 2026-10-30) print no percentages in `/usage`, and its stream report has none either, so the two readings that cost no model tokens gave nothing and the sidebar kept a day-old number. When `/usage` answers cleanly without windows, the same scheduled reading (every 15 minutes, 5 minutes apart at least) sends one tiny request instead: cheapest model, no tools, no skills, one turn, about 500 cached tokens (US$0.0001 at list price); its rate-limit event gives both windows exactly. It runs only for a login `/usage` says is on its subscription, never while extra usage runs, and only when a turn or probe of the last hour said extra usage is off, so a request past the limit is refused, not charged (with nothing known it waits for a real turn), with a US$0.005 budget. A probe that failed or cost over US$0.01 is no reading. Its windows are never stamped as zero-turn evidence for R131 and is not metered as Faber's own spend. | AI (Erick delegou) |
